name: BoJ leverage market: empty cbBTC reserve index inflated by flash-loan fees
summary: BoJ's Aave-v3-derived pool listed cbBTC as collateral with no supply, so flash-loan premiums paid into the empty reserve inflated its liquidity index while the aToken's scaled supply was dust, and rounding let a dust position count as large collateral. The attacker took cbBTC from a Morpho flash loan, left a dust deposit, looped flash loans to inflate the index and borrowed the AERO, VIRTUAL, USDC, DEGEN, MORPHO and WETH the other reserves held.
notes: Reset: the cbBTC collateral parameters set in 0xd8f16d39 (block 32861443), the last change the exploit needed; the pool proxy was created at block 32861311 running 0xf441a52f, and the later 0xd3e87baf only set cbBTC's liquidation protocol fee.
campaign.mjs found only the deployer's seeding and one user borrow before the anchor and no exercise after it. Loss is the borrowed reserves' aToken outflow; the cbBTC aToken nets to zero.
